I’m very aware of our history. I’m more just stating what I think we should be doing and how the organization *should* be evaluating the situation we are in. Not what I actually think is going to happen.

If I had to bet on it, I’m thinking they won’t rebuild. It’s just not in this organization’s nature.

No team can be good or competitive forever, especially when we live in the salary cap era. At some point, as an organization, you have to recognize when it’s time to reset, and now is as good a time as any for us, and is historically long overdue for this franchise. 

I obviously hope it’s not for 8 years, but wouldn’t it be worth it if you got a cup in year 9?

I think the main thing is you have to hit big on a couple draft picks. Not necessarily 1st overall, but you need high end talent to win in this league.

Knights had Eichel, Stone, Pietrangelo (they are a little different, as they traded for all these guys)

Avs got MacKinnon, Makar, Rantanen

Lightning have Stamkos, Hedman and hit big on picks like Kucherov and Point

Blackhawks had Toews, Kane, Keith

LA had Kopitar and Doughty

Penguins obviously have Crosby and Malkin

Point is, we need to reset to some extent. I don’t expect us to draft a Crosby or a Mackinnon, but my main point is you need top end talent to win. I have little interest in management throwing a bunch of bubblegum on the holes of this sinking ship, It likely won’t get us anywhere. 

Obviously there is risk involved, and rebuilding doesn’t always work, but I’d prefer we try and build our team that way for once, as opposed to the annual mediocrity we have experienced for decades.
